canonical_topic: REC registration and ownership transfer via registries
definition: Generators register renewable production with a registry, which cross-checks the claimed generation against actual power grid injection records to verify it. Once a REC is created, ownership transfer on a trade is simply an electronic change of owner-of-record in the registry.
core_idea: The registry is the trust and audit mechanism that ties REC issuance to verified physical generation, preventing double-counting or fabricated certificates.
key_points: Generators register production with a registry to have RECs created
The registry cross-checks generation claims against the power grid
Ownership transfer on trade is an electronic record change, with no physical delivery involved
relationships: Underpins the integrity of REC trading described elsewhere in the chapter
